_comment: aterm TRAIL-DARK-COMPOSER baseline (docs/design/PRISM-GLASS.md §15.1 P0.12): the effects harness's composer scene, Rainbow Kitty typed at 10 keys a second to a 117-cell line in Claude Code's composer (its prompt between two rules) on Default's dark ground, its terminal in the engine colours a window gives one on Default (D0D0D0 ink, Default's ANSI slots) and its cursor family resolved by a focused window's law with its live cursor (resolve_glow_config on Default, the terminal's 50FA7B cursor), from knobs a default window does not pass: cursor_trail_ms 650, cursor_trail_length 512 and cursor_trail_radius 0.4, where a default config gives 260, 24 and 0.6 (aterm-bench GlowHost::new). Of those three, Rainbow Kitty reads only the duration, so every figure here is a 650 ms trail's: the GPU time as a reference full-repaint frame's p50 over the scene's (composer_gpu_rel), and the CPU work of the producer, the CPU raster and the GPU encode as frames per 10^9 instructions retired (_per_ginsn). BIGGER-IS-BETTER. Re-record with targo --unverified verify perf --record trail-dark-composer. Re-recorded 2026-10-28 on box-4dea64151174cbad (M4 Pro 14c) when the terminal took Default's engine colours (aterm-bench b879d6128f). Re-recorded again that day, on a quiet machine (load 12.0 at the lane's start and 12.9 at its end, on 14 cores), when the cursor family took a window's config law and live cursor (aterm-bench f5782f170b): against this box's run of main's 8ffb44c7da without that change, the instruction keys did not move (emit 167.868 to 167.862, raster 315.368 to 315.352, encode 829.222 to 827.421). Its composer_gpu_rel, 1.796, was measured at ref_gpu_p50_us 258.4 (ref_blank_gpu_p50_us 156.5), and that comparison run read 1.912 at 1173.3, another GPU operating point, so no GPU move is claimed; the record before this one, 1.747, was measured at 293.9. On 2026-10-28 this box ran the scene once at f5782f170b as committed and once with a local edit of GlowHost::new to a default config's 260 ms, 24 and 0.6 (not committed): the edit laid the same under and fx quads (p50, mean and max: 10,094, 9,266 and 14,881 under) and moved the emit and raster instructions by 0.10 % or less (p50 and mean), the encode's by +0.4 % (p50) and +0.5 % (mean).
